name: Flank Speed
summary: When this model Advances, skip the Advance roll and instead add 8" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

name: God-machine
summary: This model is eligible to shoot and to declare a charge in a turn during which it Fell Back.

name: Striding Colossus
summary: Stratagems used against this model cost extra Command Points beyond their stated cost, with the surcharge scaling by this model's titan class.

name: Titanic Fire Support
summary: After this model shoots, pick one enemy unit it hit. Until end of phase, friendly Imperium attacks against that unit gain +1 Armour Penetration on a Critical Wound.

name: Wrath of the Omnissiah
summary: After this model shoots, pick one enemy unit hit by those attacks; that unit must take a Battle-shock test.
